input.summary: Delete the one-way 18-month non-solicit/no-engage covering all Vendor personnel.
input.comment: [Playbook] We deleted the one-way eighteen-month restriction because it bound only us, reached every person Vendor employed at any time, extended to engagement (a no-hire), and had no general-advertising carve-out; it also contradicted Section 12.3's confirmation that we made no no-hire commitment. If you need something here, we can accept a mutual twelve-month non-solicit limited to personnel directly involved in the Services with general-advertising and unsolicited-approach carve-outs and no hiring prohibition.
